summary: P&O Phase 4 (Cross-module Integration Hub / Project Control Center) end-to-end verified. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS (13 baseline iter103 + 6 new extra coverage iter104). Frontend Portfolio view + Single-project detail view fully working — 15 KPI tiles, 18 project rows, 7 module tabs, 5 transition buttons, blockers card, transition confirm dialog, sidebar entry under Projects & Operations all verified. Phase 1/2/3 regression intact (16 endpoints checked, no 5xx; all 18 P&O sidebar entries visible).

issues: Transition uses browser-native window.confirm()/window.prompt() instead of shadcn AlertDialog. Functional but inconsistent with rest of app's shadcn UX. Override-reason prompt is only triggered after blocker rejection (couldn't visually verify the override path in one click — multi-step). Consider replacing with a single shadcn AlertDialog with an inline textarea for override-reason.

KPI tile cards have no individual data-testid (e.g. cc-kpi-active, cc-kpi-delayed) — all 15 tiles are present visually but cannot be selected individually by automation. The agent-to-agent context notes only listed the row/tab/transition testids, so this matches the spec; flagged only as a nice-to-have.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='cc-kpi-{key}' to each of the 15 KPI tile cards in ProjectControlCenter.jsx to make portfolio counters individually selectable in tests.
(Optional) Replace native window.confirm()/window.prompt() in transition flow with a shadcn AlertDialog + inline textarea for the override reason — single-step UX consistent with the rest of the app.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 4 router (projects_ops_phase4_router.py, ~880 LoC) is approaching the 700-line soft cap — consider splitting into summaries.py (per-dimension aggregations) + blockers_alerts.py + transitions.py to keep each file focused. All cross-module reads correctly degrade gracefully (return 0/empty) when source collections are missing — verified via the regression test.

Transition endpoint correctly auto-creates an approved exception when a super_admin overrides with a reason — gated by role (super_admin/director/GM) on the approval endpoint. Permissive transition behaviour (manpower-blocker warns but doesn't block planned-projects) is per design per the agent-to-agent note.
Alert generation is idempotent by signature — re-hitting /control-center/{pid} doesn't duplicate alerts. Verified via test_alert_ack_idempotent + manual re-hit.
finance_health enum is correctly bounded to {healthy, approaching_limit, over_budget}. Margin_pct and variance_pct are computed and returned as numbers (not strings).
